background: Emirates NBD is the largest bank in Dubai, majority-owned by the Dubai government, funded by UAE deposits and lending to Dubai's corporates, government-related entities and households, with DenizBank in Turkey as its largest foreign subsidiary.
synthesis: Two of the three main agencies rate the bank, A+ on average and both on a stable outlook, the last move being a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 13 May 2025. CET1 is 13.6% and leverage a high 9.6%, with LCR at 148% and NSFR at 119%. Every ratio has fallen since 30 Jun 2025: CET1 by 1.1 points, leverage by 0.5 points, LCR by 36 points and NSFR by 11 points (figures to 30 Sep 2026), which is the trend to watch.
